title: Parrot dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7c3aff' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7c3aff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='7' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- legs dancing -->
  <path d='M44 76 L39 88' stroke='#ffb300' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M56 76 L62 86' stroke='#ffcf4d' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M36 88 L42 88' stroke='#ffb300' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M59 86 L66 88' stroke='#ffcf4d' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M40 72 Q28 80 24 92 Q32 86 40 84 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>

  <path d='M65 56 Q78 62 82 74 Q72 70 66 64 Z' fill='#27ae60'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='13' fill='#2ecc71'/>

  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='4' fill='#ff8fa3'/>

  <circle cx='54' cy='31' r='4' fill='#f0f8ff'/>
